text:
Sam: quick check — I think we saw a small regress on TTFT after the attention-kernel swap. Can someone run a short benchmark comparing master vs v0.9.3 on 7B+13B, seq=512? Need median/p95 TTFT, tok/s, and per-request latency breakdown. @Maya @Ricardo perf-bot please
Maya: on it. I'll queue a job on perf-cluster. do you want cold-start included or warm-only with KV cache primed?
Sam: warm-only (KV primed) for p95 comparison, but include a cold-start run as separate job. batch size 1 and 4.
Ricardo: noted. I'll run nvprof traces for the p95 tail sample. ETA ~2h. can you paste the exact model names you want?
Sam: models: redwood-7b-vicuna-q, redwood-13b-vicuna-q. config: seq=512, prompt length ~128, gen length 256, sampling=greedy. include token-level timestamps in output.
perf-bot: Job queued: perf-cluster/job/8792 — compares master vs v0.9.3, seq=512, batches=[1,4], warm+cold. ETA 2h. I will post results here. :robot_face:
Maya: grabbing a quick grafana panel link for the usual views — will add median/p95 and tok/s per model. link: https://grafana.internal/r/redwood/runtime-metrics
Elaine: tiny request — can we standardize the metric names before I update dashboards? we use ttft_ms, token_throughput, request_p95_ms in a few places. i'll update labels if we confirm.
Matt: pinging for metric ownership — who owns the ttft panel and alert thresholds? I think alerts live in eng-sre but runtime owns thresholds.
Ricardo: I'll own the benchmark run and the profiling artifacts. Maya you own the dashboard panel updates. Elaine you own the metric naming change PR. Matt can you coordinate alerting PR to eng-sre?
Maya: confirmed. I'll add a new panel for "TTFT p50/p95 (ms)" and "Tokens/sec" and annotate the kernel swap commit range.
Sam: proposed alert policy (draft): if request_p95_ms > 400ms for 7B (warm) for 10m -> page to oncall (SEV-2), > 250ms for 10m -> ticket. For 13B multiply thresholds by 1.4. open to adjustments.
Matt: sounds reasonable as a starting point. I'll run it by eng-sre and include historical baselines.
Ricardo: first run finished for warm batch=1, uploading artifacts to s3://redwood-perf/8792/warm-b1. Summary: master p95 TTFT 310ms, v0.9.3 p95 TTFT 275ms for 7B. tok/s roughly equal. detailed traces in S3.
Sam: interesting — master worse on p95. can you populate a small table with p50/p95/median tok/s and attach to the job?
Ricardo: done: s3://redwood-perf/8792/summary.csv (columns: model,commit,bs,ttft_p50,ttft_p95,toks_per_s).
Maya: imported summary to the grafana test panel. snapshot: https://grafana.internal/snapshot/abcd1234 — added an annotation at the commit that flipped kernels.
Elaine: opening a tiny PR to rename metrics to ttft_ms and token_throughput (will preserve old names as aliases for 2 weeks). PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-metrics/pull/112
Matt: I'll draft the alert PR once baseline is approved. also adding a small note to runbook about when to escalate.
Sam: awesome, thanks all. next steps: Ricardo attach flamegraphs for the p95 samples, Maya publish panel to prod dashboard once names land, Elaine merge metric-rename with aliases, Matt coordinate alert rollout with eng-sre. I'll follow up in this thread with the perf summary and link to the postmortem if we need one. :thumbsup:
